key.name: show-clock
key.summary: Show a large clock and the date under the search field

key.name: show-app-names
key.summary: Show app names under the big icons on tiles

key.name: accent-override
key.summary: Custom accent colour as #rrggbb; empty follows the system accent

key.name: frosted-glass
key.summary: Show a blurred copy of the wallpaper inside tiles

key.name: use-stock-grid
key.summary: Use the stock app grid instead of the home screen

key.name: layouts
key.summary: Tile layout per grid size, as JSON
key.description: Maps "COLSxROWS" to tile rectangles in grid units, keyed by folder id. Written by edit mode.

key.name: virtual-groups
key.summary: Generated groups used when the user has no app folders, as JSON

key.name: folder-orders
key.summary: App order inside folders, as JSON
key.description: Maps a folder id to the app ids in the order the user dragged them into. Apps not listed follow, most used first. Never written to org.gnome.desktop.app-folders.

key.name: known-apps
key.summary: App ids seen at the last open, used for the "New" marker

key.name: tip-dismissed
key.summary: Whether the first-run edit tip was dismissed
